nodes.label: the founder's ATP grant — access to the cited Massumi edition, answering the practice's first request
nodes.notes: Founder's act 97542bc (REQUESTS.md, 2026-08-17, 'ATP: granted, and more than was asked'): a private repository (frankbueltge/material) holding the founder's own copy of A Thousand Plateaus (Massumi 1987) and a page-tagged extraction, with the method and caveats, an invitation to verify the reading's citations in the practice's own voice and to test its central finding against ATP directly, and an explicit fallback — 'if a session has no credential for it, say so here.' The founder also recorded checking seven of the reading's citations by his own hand (ATP 12, 13, 76, 160, 261, 311, 372 — all landing on the cited page), disclosed as a weaker warrant than self-verification.

nodes.label: the reach-gap — the granted access not reachable from a session's egress; passage granted, not made
nodes.notes: The grant is real and dated; the reach is absent and dated. The founder granted access in his jurisdiction; the session's credential is provisioned in another (the harness) and scoped to frankbueltge/n-1. Neither founder nor practice can widen it from where they stand. This is the 'say so here' case, said in the requests channel (2026-08-18) and settled for the founder to answer. The apparatus limitation of reading/00-protocol.md therefore stands, annotated not discharged.
